scope: These are separately named lower-cost physical workflows over the same rows. They omit paired Geometry methods and duplicate omitted/null forms; they do not make the preserved full formulas fit the shared budget and are not new API compatibility results.

default_wgs84_feature_only.description: Wave71 WGS84 Feature-only physical CSV v4
default_wgs84_feature_only.map_behavior: FeatureCollection.map calls Feature.area/length/perimeter once each with omitted projection and Feature.centroid once, then returns that actual centroid Feature with source identity and computed properties. This is a separately named lean workflow; the original v2 Geometry+Feature omitted/null formula remains a preserved budget rejection.

explicit_epsg4326_planar_geometrycollect.description: Wave71 planar GeometryCollection Feature-only physical CSV v4
explicit_epsg4326_planar_geometrycollect.map_behavior: FeatureCollection.map calls Feature.area/length/perimeter once each with explicit EPSG:4326 and Feature.centroid once, then returns that actual centroid Feature with source identity and computed properties. The last row is the separately documented GeometryCollection of the same two atomic polygons; the original full Geometry+Feature route remains a preserved budget rejection.
